JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnableLeave: If enabled, leaves will spawn on all outdoor locations.
If enabled, leaves can spawn even when it is raining.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnableDynam: If enabled, rain density will change dynamically throughout the day.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.RainDensity: How often the rain density can change.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnableWindD: If enabled, logs detailed wind pattern, direction, speed, and DNA parameters to the SMAPI console whenever the weather changes.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnablePuddl: If enabled, puddles will form during and after rainy days.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnableLeafP: If enabled, interactive leaf and snow mounds and puddles will generate on calm days.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnableMorni: If enabled, morning dew and late fall frost will appear on grass.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Config.EnableFog.T: If enabled, ground mist and high fog clouds will generate dynamically.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Log.CalmDay: WEATHER UPDATED: CALM DAY (No wind, no leaves)
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Log.CalmDayTrace: Weather updated: Calm day (No wind, no leaves)
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Command.LeafPilesF: Leaf/snow piles forced on current location.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Command.CalmDayFor: Total calm day (no wind, no leaves) forced. Leaf piles updated.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Command.Atmosphere: Morning dew and fog forced for today.
Morning dew and fog returned to natural weather cycle.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Command.FogReset: Fog returned to natural weather cycle.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.CommandDesc.Status: Shows the internal status of the mod's leaves.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.CommandDesc.Foresh: Forces rain foreshadowing to test the night animation.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.CommandDesc.Calm: Forces a calm day with no wind and no leaves.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.CommandDesc.LeafPi: Forces leaf/snow piles to spawn on the current map.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.CommandDesc.Atmosp: Forces morning dew and two-layer fog on the current map.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.CommandDesc.Fog: Forces or cycles fog layers (Light, Moderate, Dense, Low, High, Off) on the current map.
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Atmosphere.Fog.Mod: Moderate (Valley radiation fog, low & mid banks)
JP98.DebrisIsInTheAir.Atmosphere.Fog.Den: Dense (Full map blanket cover, high & low banks)
